name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-jungle-entrance
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Jungle (Entrance)
description:
C3 2023 WINTER SUBMISSION

The background seen in the first action stage from the obscure game SNES port from Popful Mail, a surprisingly decent and fun game. The background can be used with horizontal levels with verticality, as long you expand the sky or grass part on the lower part. A great fit for jungles in general.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
